scope: tracked local development experiments only; no clinical validation or promotion

experiments.hypothesis: Adding the candidate paracetamol hotword will improve positive medication-term recall without worsening normalized WER or creating false insertions on paired development windows.

result.interpretation: Target recall improved, but the predeclared no-WER-regression/no-false-insertion hypothesis failed. Do not promote the biasing candidate.

limitations: Development mock references are not independently adjudicated clinical gold.
The eight paired windows are a small, selected pilot and do not establish full-consultation performance.
